summary: A ROS Answers question from 2014-06-16 by user xuningy about the /collision_map_out topic (published via mapping_rviz_plugin) not displaying in RViz with octomap_server. The asker had installed and verified mapping_rviz_plugin and changed PLUGINLIB_DEPEND_CLASS to PLUGINLIB_EXPORT_CLASS in init.cpp, but adding the Display CollisionMap produced repeated 'Object::connect: No such slot rviz::Display::...' errors for signals such as changedTopic, changedColor and changedAlpha. The asker included the header collision_map_display.h, which declares the slot methods without Q_OBJECT or Q_SLOTS. A comment from the asker reports the fix: adding Q_OBJECT and Q_SLOTS and passing fixed_frame_ to the MessageFilter in collision_map_display.cpp made it work.
one_line: ROS Answers question on why the /collision_map_out topic from mapping_rviz_plugin fails to display in RViz, with Qt slot-connection errors and the asker's eventual fix.
key_facts: The question was asked on 2014-06-16 at 15:13:34 -0500 by user xuningy on ROS Answers.
The question was tagged collision_map_out, mapping_rviz_plugin, octomap_server, collision_map and arm_navigation_msgs.
The asker wanted to display the /collision_map_out topic in RViz using the mapping_rviz_plugin.
The asker changed init.cpp to use PLUGINLIB_EXPORT_CLASS instead of PLUGINLIB_DEPEND_CLASS.
Adding the Display CollisionMap in RViz produced 'Object::connect: No such slot rviz::Display::changedOverrideColor()' and similar errors.
The error messages list missing slots changedOverrideColor, changedColor, changedRenderOperation, changedAlpha, changedPointSize and changedTopic.
The header collision_map_display.h declares the CollisionMapDisplay class with its Q_OBJECT line commented out (//Q_OBJECT).
The header's CollisionMapDisplay class derives from rviz::Display and uses arm_navigation_msgs::CollisionMap messages.
The asker's comment on 2014-06-17 says the problem was solved by adding Q_OBJECT and Q_SLOTS arguments.
The asker also added a fixed_frame_ argument to the MessageFilter in collision_map_display.cpp, after which the plugin worked.
The page notes that answers.ros.org was deprecated as of August 11, 2023 in favor of robotics.stackexchange.com.
The question had 101 views recorded at the time of capture... Seen 265 times, with the last update on Jun 16 '14.
